assumptions: Run Delivery Session applies to a hot-fix
Draft delivering pull request and published review record are supplied
Initial Validate Agent Review during Verify Hot-Fix Readiness reports stale-head
Required fixes fit the run allowance

result.next_action: Keep the pull request in draft and continue directly to Repair Hot-Fix Findings.
reachable_before_repair: The full-metadata Read Pull Request State and initial Validate Agent Review have occurred
not_reachable_before_repair: Subsequent readiness Read Pull Request State and second Validate Agent Review
repair_and_retry: Resolve the finding on the task branch. Stale-head evidence requires a complete review of the current head; changing the record SHA alone is insufficient. A source edit is needed only if review discovers a defect.

Repeat step 9 from Produce Agent Review with fresh metadata and updated validation evidence. Inspect the complete target-to-head diff, affected definitions and callers, every criterion and failure paths. Fix required findings and run appropriate regressions.
Populate and Publish Planning Record on engineering, then Publish Pull Request to link that published record.
Read fresh full pull-request metadata and Validate Agent Review with published records. Any finding again routes directly to repair while draft.
Only a draft with passing evidence reaches Mark Review Ready using its node_id.

Read Pull Request State again and Validate Agent Review against that fresh metadata and the same published records; retain confirmed Review State or Failure. Repeat repair and review until validation and ready-state readback provide no finding.
merge_continuation: After successful validation and ready-state readback, step 10 publishes check results and applies Merge Task Pull Requests.
Merge requires current passing test-plan and head evidence, protection and active rules, reviews, stable verified head, repository auto-close prerequisite and merge authorization.
A target requiring human approval ends in a ready-for-approval handoff; the agent cannot self-approve or bypass requirements. Merge Permission reserves default-branch merging for a person.
A confirmed merge follows Task Merge. Hot-fix issue delivery, eligible closure and board settlement are recorded, then control returns to the session.
result.outside_allowance: Stop before Merge; keep the hot-fix held and PR draft; return all open findings.
result.record_currency: For a hot-fix, a current record names the current head SHA and base_ref. Advancing the target SHA alone does not stale it. A stale head requires fresh review.
